summary: 澳大利亚农田盐碱化与地下地形、盐分和水的移动有关。文章由农户经历和治理难题切入，介绍怎样结合电磁、放射测量等数据定位风险，比较干预方案。
logic: 借农户经历展示治理难度
用不同探测手段追踪分布
整合资料预测并试验方案

paragraphs.brief: 从地下古河道追踪盐分
sentences: Beneath the flat, impassive surface of Australia lie hidden mountains, valleys and gorges – ancient traps and channels for the deadly salt that is stealthily killing so much of the Australian landscape.
澳大利亚平坦、看似平静的地表下，隐藏着山脉、谷地和峡谷；这些古老地形储存并输送盐分，而盐分正悄悄侵蚀大片土地。
The war on salt is calling forth new weapons.
应对盐害需要新的手段。

A suite of high technologies used by geologists to see underground and prospect for gold and minerals is now being used to pinpoint the presence of salt beneath the landscape, and to predict where it might move.
地质学家原本用来探查地下、勘探黄金和矿产的一系列技术，如今被用于定位地下盐分，并预测其移动方向。
paragraphs.gist: 澳大利亚看似平坦的地表下有古老沟谷和盐分通道，原本供地质学家寻找矿藏的技术正被用来定位地下盐并预判其去向。

paragraphs.brief: 提高探测精度避免防治落空
sentences: Unless this process is clearly understood, warns Chief of Exploration and Mining Dr Neil Phillips, the hard work now underway of planning and tree-planting on the surface may be rendered ineffective: salt can still sneak past and erupt, following one of the ancient river channels formed millions of years ago.
勘探与采矿负责人尼尔·菲利普斯博士警告，如果不了解地下盐分如何移动，眼下辛苦进行的地表规划和植树就可能徒劳：盐分仍可沿数百万年前形成的古河道绕过拦截，在别处冒出。

The use of airborne electromagnetics to detect salt hidden beneath the landscape has been around for a decade, but the past two years have seen a major development in its precision and powers of detection.
利用空中电磁探测地表地下隐藏的盐已有10年之久，但过去两年在精确度和探测能力方面有了重大发展。
Like the use of radar in battles, it has the potential to turn the tide of the struggle in favour of the defence by helping to pinpoint, plot and predict the movements of the foe.
这种技术就像战场上的雷达，能找准盐分的位置，描绘和预测其动向，因而有望使防治工作掌握主动。
paragraphs.gist: 盐水可能沿数百万年前的河道绕过地面防治，探测精度不断提高的航空电磁技术因而有望使规划和植树更有针对性。

paragraphs.brief: 农民见证盐斑不断扩散
sentences: Angus Howell, who farms near Warrenbayne, in Southeast Australia, saw his first outbreak of salt in 1948.
在澳大利亚东南部沃伦贝恩附近务农的安格斯·豪厄尔，1948年第一次在地里见到盐害。
Over the ensuing decades the patches spread and multiplied until they consumed almost 100 hectares.
此后几十年，盐斑不断扩大、增多，最终侵占了近100公顷土地。
By the late 1970s, Howell and his fellow farmers had decided it was time for action and established a government-funded “Landcare” group in a bid to save Australia’s farmland.
到了1970年代末，Howell和他的农民伙伴们决定现在是采取行动的时候了，并成立了一个由政府资助的“土地保护”小组，以拯救澳大利亚的农田。
But despite a mounting effort by scientists, farmers and governments, the “white death” continued to encroach.
但是，尽管科学家、农民和政府作出越来越大的努力，“白死”现象继续蔓延。
Small successes were eclipsed by larger defeats and fresh outbreaks.
更大的失败和新的爆发使一些小的成功蒙上了阴影。
paragraphs.gist: 豪厄尔自1948年起目睹盐斑扩至近百公顷，他与农民组成政府资助的土地保护小组，局部成效却未遏止新的大范围侵袭。

paragraphs.brief: 地下通道与治理现实难题
sentences: “The technical solutions just aren’t there yet for dealing with broadacre salinity, nor are the social and economic solutions.
“要治理大面积农田盐碱化，目前还没有合适的技术方案，在社会和经济层面也没有答案。
How do you introduce the land-use changes that are needed when people still need to make a living?”
当人们仍然需要谋生时，如何进行土地使用方面的变革？”
Howell asks.
豪厄尔问。
There is no satisfactory solution yet.
目前还没有令人满意的解决办法。
Part of the problem has lain in salt’s ability to mount ambushes, emerging somewhere new, sometimes unexpected and unexplained, beating plans to intercept it.
难点之一是，盐分能像打伏击一样在新地点冒出，位置有时出人意料、原因不明，使原定拦截方案落空。
Only now are scientists starting to really disclose its secret subterranean stores and passages.
直到现在，科学家才开始真正揭开地下盐分储藏区和流动通道的秘密。
paragraphs.gist: 治理大片农田盐害既受地下盐水去向难测的制约，也须面对农民仍要谋生的现实，科学家才刚逐渐摸清地下储藏与通道。

paragraphs.brief: 盐碱化的规模与长期威胁
sentences: The need for such knowledge is pressing.
迫切需要这种知识。
Salt has already afflicted six million hectares of once-productive country.
盐害已经侵袭了六百万公顷原本富饶的土地。

At present rates, it is predicted that, by 2050, it will have sterilised a total of 17 million hectares and the waters of Australia’s Murray River will regularly exceed the World Health Organisation’s salt limits for drinking water.
按目前的速度，预计到 2050 年，盐碱化将使总计 1,700 万公顷的土地失去生产力；澳大利亚墨累河河水的含盐量也会经常超过世界卫生组织规定的饮用水上限。
Defeating this assault may take centuries, not decades.
击败这种攻击可能需要几个世纪，而不是几十年。
paragraphs.gist: 盐害已侵袭六百万公顷原有生产力的土地，文中预测若趋势不变，到2050年受损面积和默里河饮水盐度都会大幅恶化。

paragraphs.brief: 电磁与磁力调查的分工
sentences: Electromagnetic surveys measure the electrical conductivity of soil to reveal the distribution of salt and the nature and variability of the regolith – the weathered rock and sediment that may lie above the bedrock.
电磁勘测通过测量土壤电导率揭示盐分的分布，也能反映表土覆盖层的性质和变化，即基岩上方可能存在的风化岩石及沉积物。

Magnetic surveys measure small differences in the Earth’s magnetic field, enabling scientists to probe the deep past and reconstruct ancient landscapes – rivers, basins and faults now buried under tens of metres of sediment.
磁力勘测通过测量地球磁场的微小差异，让科学家追溯久远的过去，重建如今埋在几十米深沉积物下的河流、盆地和断层等古地貌。
These features help to reveal where groundwater is stored, dictate the direction of groundwater movement, and are critical to predicting or ruling out salinity hot-spots.
这些特征有助于揭示地下水储存的地点，决定地下水流动的方向，对于预测或排除盐度热点至关重要。
paragraphs.gist: 电磁调查以土壤导电性判断盐和风化层分布，磁测则重建埋藏的古河道与断层，两种信息都帮助预测地下水流向和盐害热点。

paragraphs.brief: 地表排水无法预测地下流向
sentences: Radiometric analysis is based on the detection of radiation emitted by elements contained in rocks and soils, allowing scientists to delineate landforms.
辐射测量分析的基础是检测岩石和土壤所含元素所释放的辐射，使科学家能够划定陆地形态。
These factors influence the mobility of salt through the soil profile and help determine where to plant particular crop species to tackle the problem.
这些因素影响盐在土壤中的流动，并有助于确定在什么地方种植特定作物来解决这一问题。
Using data from the Murray River region, scientists have revealed a network of ancient drainage systems that channelled water beneath the current land-surface.
科学家利用墨累河地区的数据，揭示了一张古水系网，古河道在今天的地表以下输水。
These buried channels may carry salt and sometimes run at right angles to channels on the surface.
这些埋藏的河道可能携带盐分，走向有时与地表河道成直角。
This implies that the salt could move underground in quite a different direction to what one would expect by looking at surface slope and drainage.
这意味着地下盐分的移动方向，可能与人们根据地面坡度和排水状况推测的完全不同。
paragraphs.gist: 放射性测量揭示地貌及其对盐迁移的影响，默里河区的古排水道有时与地表水道垂直，说明仅看表面坡度可能判断错方向。

paragraphs.brief: 整合技术建立四维盐分图
sentences: One of the biggest advances in detection, says Professor Neil Phillips, has come with the integration of different techniques such as magnetics, electromagnetics and radiometrics, and ground mapping.
Neil Phillips教授说，在探测方面最大的进步之一，是结合了磁力、电磁和辐射测量以及地面测绘等不同技术。
Individually, these technologies only gave clues to what was going on underground.
单独使用时，这些技术只能为地下情形提供零星线索。
Together they provide a far more revealing picture of the subsurface landscape, several hundred metres deep.
结合起来，它们能更清楚地呈现深入地表以下数百米的地貌。

Advanced airborne electromagnetics, in particular, enables scientists to take “slices” of the landscape at depths of five metres, ten metres, fifteen metres and so on, to determine where salt may be stored at depth.
尤其是先进的航空电磁勘测，可以获取地下五米、十米、十五米等不同深度的“切片”，定位深处潜在的盐分储藏区。
This is building up a four-dimensional picture of the subsurface landscape, enabling researchers to understand movements of salt in length, breadth, depth and time.
这些资料逐步构成地下地貌的四维图像，使研究者了解盐分在长、宽、深三个维度及时间上的变化。

From such technologies it will be possible to locate salt stores, identify how saline they are, look at man-made and natural changes to the landscape that may cause it to mobilise, and then predict where it will head to and over what time span.
有了这些技术，就能定位盐分储藏区、确定其含盐程度，研究哪些人为或自然地貌变化可能使盐分移动，进而预测它会朝哪里移动、需要多长时间。
This in turn will give the salt warriors time to model various ways of containing or curbing the menace, see what works best and then try it out on the ground.
这样，盐害治理人员就有时间模拟各种控制办法，比较效果，再到现场试行最合适的方案。
paragraphs.gist: 结合磁测、电磁、放射性测量与地面制图，可逐层看清地下盐库并追踪其随时间的迁移，让研究者先模拟再实地试验防治方案。

items.en: a prediction of the future risk of salt to water supplies.
items.zh: 预测盐分未来可能给供水带来的风险。
items.why: E 段预测到 2050 年，墨累河水的盐度会经常超过相关标准，指出盐害将来对水源构成的风险。

items.en: the reason why technologies must be combined to be effective.
items.zh: 技术必须结合起来才能有效的原因。
items.why: H 段解释，合并不同技术所得的数据，能更清楚地显示地下数百米的地形；单项观测提供的信息不够完整。

items.en: a reference to the recent improvements in the accuracy of airborne electromagnetics.
items.zh: 提到航空电磁探测的精度近期有所提高。
items.why: B 段比较航空电磁探测在过去十年和最近两年的表现，明确写到新近在精度和探测能力上的提升。

items.en: the organization of concerned farmers into an official body.
items.zh: 关心盐害的农民组织起来，成立正式团体。
items.why: C 段写豪威尔与其他农民决定行动，共同成立由政府资助的 Landcare 团体，这就是忧虑盐害的农民正式组织起来的经过。

items.en: the estimated length of time salinity is likely to be a problem.
items.zh: 估计盐碱化问题可能持续多长时间。
items.why: E 段估计，克服盐害可能要用数百年，而不仅是几十年，直接回答问题可能持续多久。

items.en: a summary of stages in a proposed plan of action to combat the salt problem.
items.zh: 一份拟议行动计划的阶段摘要，以解决盐问题。
items.why: H 段依序列出找出盐分储藏点、测定盐度、识别引起迁移的地形变化，以及预测盐分走向等步骤。

items.en: the possibility that current re-vegetation practices are a waste of time.
items.zh: 目前恢复植被的做法可能徒劳无功。
items.why: B 段警告，若不了解地下盐分如何移动，地表的规划和植树可能徒劳，正是当前恢复植被措施或会无效的可能性。

items.answer: B · can show the composition of the top layer of the ground.
items.solution: 能够显示地面顶层的构成。

items.answer: A · can help farmers choose the best location for plants.
items.solution: 能帮助农民为不同植物选取合适地点。

items.answer: C · can detect how far below ground the salt is.
items.solution: 能探测盐分埋藏在地下多深。

items.en: What link does the writer make between salt and gold?
items.zh: 作者在盐和黄金之间建立了什么联系？
correct: The same techniques can be used to find both.
同样的探测技术可以用来寻找这两者。

items.en: What is the ‘process’ referred to in Section B?
correct: salt’s ability to travel below ground
盐分在地下迁移的过程。

items.en: According to Angus Howell, one problem in the fight against salinity is that
items.zh: 安格斯·豪厄尔说防治盐碱化的一个问题就是
correct: some possible measures may cause farmers to lose income.
一些可能的措施可能会使农民失去收入。

items.en: Which of the following best describes the writer’s view of the salinity problem in Australia?
items.zh: 哪一项最能概括作者对澳大利亚盐害的看法？
correct: Farmers are fighting an enemy that moves secretly and hides well.
农民面对的敌人善于隐蔽，会在不知不觉间转移。

pairs: 都是在说探测技术比以前更精确，accuracy 换成了 precision。
choose the best location for plants
determine where to plant particular crop species
“为植物选地点”在原文具体化为“确定每种作物该种在哪里”。
how far below ground the salt is
where salt may be stored at depth
两处都问盐在地下多深。原文提到按不同深度为地层成像。
原文用植树具体说明恢复植被的做法
points: E 段预测到 2050 年，墨累河水的盐度会经常超过相关标准，指出盐害将来对水源构成的风险。
题干问“辐射测量分析”。定位句写到“这些因素影响盐在土壤中的流动，并有助于确定在什么地方种植特定作物来解决这一问题”。
clauses: …, warns Chief of Exploration and Mining Dr Neil Phillips, the hard work now underway of planning and tree-planting on the surface may be rendered ineffective: salt can still sneak past and erupt, following one of the ancient river channels formed millions of years ago.
连接词 unless 引出“Unless this process is clearly understood”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 unless 把这一层关系补进去。
Over the ensuing decades the patches spread and multiplied ….
连接词 until 引出“until they consumed almost 100 hectares”，说明主句的时间关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 until 把这一层关系补进去。
lead: One of the most serious problems facing Australian farmers is an increase in the salt content in the soil.
澳大利亚农民面临的最严重问题之一是土壤中的盐含量增加。
However, there are new weapons emerging in the fight against salinity.
然而，在防治盐碱化的斗争中出现了新的武器。
